faqs.question: Can I connect a monitor to my laptop?
faqs.answer: Yes, as long as your laptop has a matching port, usually HDMI or USB-C with display output. Check your laptop's ports before choosing a monitor or cable.

seoDescription: Shop genuine laptops in Nepal: student, business and gaming laptops from top brands. Full specs, cash on delivery, nationwide delivery.
seoContent:
## Buy laptops in Nepal

A laptop is an investment you will rely on for years of study or work, so it pays to match it to how you will use it. We stock genuine laptops for students, professionals, creators and gamers.

## Choosing a laptop by use

- Students: a light laptop with long battery life, 8 to 16 GB RAM and an SSD
- Office and business: a comfortable keyboard, a good webcam, solid build and enough ports
- Programming and design: 16 GB RAM or more, a fast processor and a sharp, colour-accurate display
- Gaming: a dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX or AMD Radeon graphics card, a high refresh rate screen and strong cooling

## Checklist before you buy

- Processor generation, not just the name (a newer Core i5 can beat an older Core i7)
- RAM type and whether it can be upgraded
- SSD size and whether there is a spare slot
- Screen size, resolution, brightness and refresh rate
- Battery life, weight and charger type (USB-C charging is convenient)
- Ports: USB-A, USB-C, HDMI and a headphone jack

Every laptop at 361 Gadgets is a genuine product with its full specifications listed on the product page.

faqs.question: Which laptop is best for students in Nepal?
faqs.answer: Look for a light laptop with an Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5 (or newer equivalent), at least 8 GB RAM, a 512 GB SSD and good battery life. That covers online classes, assignments and programming for several years.

faqs.question: What should I look for in a gaming laptop?
faqs.answer: A dedicated graphics card is the most important part, followed by the processor, 16 GB RAM, a 120 Hz or faster display and a cooling system that keeps the laptop stable during long sessions.

faqs.question: Can I upgrade the RAM or SSD later?
faqs.answer: Many laptops have a spare SSD slot or replaceable RAM, but thin models often have RAM soldered to the board. Check the specifications, or ask us about a particular model before buying.

faqs.question: Does the laptop come with Windows?
faqs.answer: It depends on the model. The product page states the operating system that comes installed.

seoDescription: Buy genuine gaming laptops in Nepal with RTX graphics, high refresh rate screens and fast processors. Cash on delivery.
seoContent:
## Buy gaming laptops in Nepal

A gaming laptop packs a dedicated graphics card, a fast processor and a high refresh rate screen into a portable machine for gaming, streaming and creative work.

## What to compare

- Graphics card (GPU): the most important part for gaming performance
- Processor (CPU): a recent Intel Core i5/i7 or AMD Ryzen 5/7 or better
- RAM: 16 GB is the sweet spot for modern games
- Screen: 144 Hz or higher for smooth gameplay
- Storage: an SSD of 512 GB or more, as games are large
- Cooling: gaming laptops run hot, so a good cooling design matters

You can pay with cash on delivery or eSewa, and we deliver inside Kathmandu Valley and to every district in Nepal.

faqs.question: Which graphics card do I need for gaming?
faqs.answer: For smooth 1080p gaming in most new titles, an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050 or 4060 class GPU, or an AMD equivalent, is a good starting point.

faqs.question: Can I upgrade the RAM and storage later?
faqs.answer: Many gaming laptops have upgradeable RAM and a spare SSD slot. Check the product page or ask us before buying.

faqs.question: Is a gaming laptop good for students?
faqs.answer: Yes, if you also need power for gaming, design or video editing. For study only, a lighter student laptop gives better battery life.

seoDescription: Buy genuine MacBook Air and MacBook Pro in Nepal with Apple silicon. Long battery life for study, work and creative projects.
seoContent:
## Buy MacBooks in Nepal

MacBooks with Apple silicon are fast, silent and have some of the longest battery lives of any laptop, which makes them a favourite with students, professionals and creators.

## Which MacBook?

- MacBook Air: thin, light and fanless, ideal for study, office work and everyday use
- MacBook Pro: more power, better cooling and brighter screens for video editing, design and development

## Before you buy

Choose enough memory (RAM) and storage up front, as they cannot be upgraded later. 16 GB of memory is a good choice for most people, and more storage helps if you keep photos and videos on the laptop.

You can pay with cash on delivery or eSewa, and we deliver inside Kathmandu Valley and to every district in Nepal.

faqs.question: MacBook Air or MacBook Pro: which should I buy?
faqs.answer: MacBook Air is enough for study, office work and light editing. Choose MacBook Pro for heavy video editing, 3D or long, demanding workloads.

faqs.question: Can I upgrade a MacBook's RAM or storage later?
faqs.answer: No. MacBook memory and storage are built in, so choose the right amount when you buy.

faqs.question: Are your MacBooks genuine and new?
faqs.answer: Yes. We sell only genuine, brand-new MacBooks.

seoDescription: Buy laptops for students and office work in Nepal: light, reliable laptops with long battery life at every budget.
seoContent:
## Buy student and office laptops in Nepal

For classes, assignments, online meetings and office work you need a laptop that is reliable, light to carry and lasts through the day, without paying for gaming hardware you will not use.

## What to look for

- Processor: Intel Core i3/i5, AMD Ryzen 3/5 or newer
- RAM: 8 GB minimum, 16 GB for heavy multitasking
- Storage: an SSD, never a hard drive, for fast start-up
- Battery: look for all-day battery life
- Weight: under about 1.6 kg is comfortable to carry daily
- Ports: USB-A and HDMI are handy for projectors and pen drives

You can pay with cash on delivery or eSewa, and we deliver inside Kathmandu Valley and to every district in Nepal.

faqs.question: Which laptop is best for students in Nepal?
faqs.answer: A light laptop with an SSD, 8 to 16 GB of RAM and good battery life suits most courses. Engineering and design students may need a more powerful one.

faqs.question: Does the laptop come with Windows?
faqs.answer: Most laptops come with Windows pre-installed. The product page says which operating system is included.

faqs.question: Can I use this laptop for online classes?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every laptop here has a webcam and microphone suitable for Zoom, Teams and Google Meet.

seoContent:
## Buy computer accessories in Nepal

The right accessories make your laptop or PC faster and more comfortable to use every day. At 361 Gadgets every accessory is genuine and from trusted brands.

## In this section

- Monitors: a second or bigger screen for work, study and gaming
- Keyboards: wired and wireless keyboards, including compact and mechanical ones

## Check compatibility

You can pay with cash on delivery or eSewa, and we deliver inside Kathmandu Valley and to every district in Nepal.

faqs.question: Will a wireless keyboard and mouse work with my laptop?
faqs.answer: Yes. They connect by Bluetooth or a small USB receiver and work with Windows and macOS. If your laptop has only USB-C ports, choose a Bluetooth model or use an adapter.

faqs.question: Can I connect a monitor to my laptop?
faqs.answer: Yes, if your laptop has HDMI or USB-C with display output. Check your laptop's ports before choosing a monitor and cable.

faqs.question: Which laptop bag size should I buy?
faqs.answer: Match the bag to your laptop's screen size, for example a 15.6 inch bag for a 15.6 inch laptop. A slightly larger bag is fine, a smaller one is not.

seoDescription: Buy genuine monitors in Nepal: Full HD, QHD and 4K displays, IPS panels and high refresh rate gaming monitors from top brands.
seoContent:
## Buy monitors in Nepal

A good monitor reduces eye strain, gives you more room to work and makes games and videos look their best. Adding a second screen to a laptop is one of the best productivity upgrades you can make.

## How to choose a monitor

- Size and resolution: 24-inch at Full HD (1080p) for everyday use, 27-inch at QHD (1440p) for sharper text, 4K for design and media
- Panel type: IPS for accurate colours and wide viewing angles, VA for deep contrast, fast IPS or TN for competitive gaming
- Refresh rate: 60 to 75 Hz for office work, 144 Hz or higher for smooth gaming
- Connections: HDMI and DisplayPort; USB-C with power delivery can charge a laptop through one cable
- Ergonomics: height adjustment and VESA mount support help posture

All monitors at 361 Gadgets are genuine, with full specifications on each product page.

faqs.question: What monitor size is best for a desk?
faqs.answer: 24 inches suits most desks and Full HD resolution. 27 inches works well at QHD and gives more space for multitasking. Larger or ultrawide monitors need a deeper desk.

faqs.question: Do I need a 144 Hz monitor?
faqs.answer: For gaming, yes: a higher refresh rate makes motion much smoother if your PC can produce the frame rates. For office work and video, 60 to 75 Hz is fine.

faqs.question: Can I connect a monitor to my laptop?
faqs.answer: Yes, through HDMI, DisplayPort or USB-C, depending on the ports your laptop has. A USB-C monitor can also charge a compatible laptop over the same cable.

seoDescription: Shop genuine keyboards in Nepal: wireless, mechanical and compact keyboards for office, study and programming.
seoContent:
## Buy keyboards in Nepal

If you type for hours every day, a better keyboard is one of the most worthwhile upgrades. The right one is more comfortable, more accurate and lasts for years.

## Types of keyboards

- Membrane: quiet and affordable, good for offices and shared spaces
- Mechanical: individual switches with a crisp, durable feel, popular with programmers and writers
- Low-profile: slim keys similar to a laptop, comfortable for fast typing
- Wireless: Bluetooth or a 2.4 GHz receiver for a tidy desk; many switch between several devices

## Layout and size

- Full-size with a number pad for accounting and data entry
- Tenkeyless (TKL) and 75 percent layouts save space and keep the mouse closer
- Check compatibility with Windows and macOS key layouts

All keyboards we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Is a mechanical keyboard worth it for typing?
faqs.answer: Many people find mechanical keyboards more comfortable and accurate for long typing sessions, and they last much longer. Quieter switch types are available if you share a room or office.

faqs.question: Can one keyboard connect to my laptop and tablet?
faqs.answer: Yes. Multi-device Bluetooth keyboards can pair with several devices and switch between them with a key.

faqs.question: Do wireless keyboards have lag?
faqs.answer: Not noticeably for typing. For competitive gaming, a wired keyboard or a low-latency 2.4 GHz wireless model is better.

seoDescription: Buy genuine computer mice in Nepal: wireless, ergonomic and silent mice for laptops and desktops. Delivered across Nepal.
seoContent:
## Buy a computer mouse in Nepal

A good mouse makes work faster and kinder to your wrist than a laptop touchpad. Whether you need a compact mouse for travel or an ergonomic one for all-day use, the right shape matters most.

## How to choose a mouse

- Connection: 2.4 GHz wireless for reliability, Bluetooth to avoid using a USB port, or wired for zero charging
- Shape: ambidextrous, right-handed contoured or vertical ergonomic designs
- Size: match the mouse to your hand size and grip style
- Battery: rechargeable over USB-C or long-life AA / AAA batteries
- Extras: silent clicks for shared spaces, extra side buttons and multi-device switching

For gaming mice with high DPI sensors and programmable buttons, see our gaming mouse section. All mice we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Is a vertical mouse better for wrist pain?
faqs.answer: Many people with wrist strain find a vertical mouse more comfortable because it keeps the hand in a natural handshake position. It takes a few days to get used to.

faqs.question: Will a wireless mouse work with a MacBook?
faqs.answer: Yes. Bluetooth mice connect directly. Mice with a USB-A receiver need a USB-C adapter or hub on MacBooks that only have USB-C ports.

faqs.question: How long does a wireless mouse battery last?
faqs.answer: Rechargeable mice often last weeks per charge, and many AA-powered mice last a year or more. The product page lists the brand's figures.

seoDescription: Buy genuine webcams in Nepal: 1080p and 4K webcams with clear microphones for online classes, meetings and streaming.
seoContent:
## Buy webcams in Nepal

Built-in laptop cameras are often blurry and dark. A dedicated webcam makes you look and sound far better in online classes, job interviews, client meetings and live streams.

## How to choose a webcam

- Resolution: 1080p is the standard for clear video; 2K and 4K add detail for streaming and recording
- Frame rate: 30 fps for calls, 60 fps for smoother streams
- Low-light performance: matters for rooms without good lighting
- Microphone: built-in noise-reducing mics help if you do not use a headset
- Field of view: wider lenses fit more people in the frame for group calls
- Mount: a clip that fits monitors and laptops, and a tripod thread for flexibility
- Privacy: a built-in shutter or cover

All webcams we sell are genuine and work with Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams and other apps.

faqs.question: Do webcams need drivers?
faqs.answer: Most webcams are plug and play over USB on Windows and macOS. Some brands offer optional software for extra settings.

faqs.question: Is 1080p enough for online classes and meetings?
faqs.answer: Yes. Most video call apps send video at 720p or 1080p, so a good 1080p webcam with decent low-light performance is all most people need.

faqs.question: Can I use a webcam with a desktop PC?
faqs.answer: Yes. A webcam is the easiest way to add a camera and microphone to a desktop, which usually has neither built in.

seoDescription: Buy laptop bags and backpacks in Nepal: padded, water-resistant bags for 13 to 17-inch laptops, for college, office and travel.
seoContent:
## Buy laptop bags in Nepal

A laptop bag protects an expensive device from bumps, dust and rain on bus rides, motorbike commutes and trips. A good bag also keeps chargers, notebooks and accessories organised.

## Types of laptop bags

- Backpacks: the most comfortable for commuting and walking, with weight on both shoulders
- Messenger and briefcase bags: a smart look for office and meetings
- Sleeves: slim protection to slip into another bag

## What to look for

- The right size for your laptop's screen size
- A padded laptop compartment, ideally raised from the bottom of the bag
- Water-resistant fabric for monsoon season
- Padded, adjustable straps and back panel
- Pockets for a charger, power bank, cables and documents
- Anti-theft features such as hidden zips for crowded buses

All laptop bags at 361 Gadgets are genuine.

faqs.question: Will a 15.6-inch bag fit a 14-inch laptop?
faqs.answer: Yes, but the laptop may move around. A bag sized for your exact laptop holds it more securely; check the compartment dimensions on the product page.

faqs.question: Are these bags waterproof?
faqs.answer: Many are water-resistant, which protects against light rain. In heavy monsoon rain, a rain cover or keeping the laptop in a sleeve inside the bag adds protection.

faqs.question: Is a backpack better than a shoulder bag?
faqs.answer: For daily commuting and walking, yes: a backpack spreads the weight across both shoulders and leaves your hands free.

seoDescription: Buy USB hubs in Nepal: USB-C and USB-A hubs with HDMI, card readers and charging to add ports to laptops and MacBooks.
seoContent:
## Buy USB hubs in Nepal

Many modern laptops, especially MacBooks and thin ultrabooks, come with only one or two USB-C ports. A USB hub adds the ports you need for a mouse, pen drive, external monitor, SD card and charger.

## How to choose a USB hub

- Input: USB-C hubs for modern laptops, USB-A hubs for older computers
- Ports: USB-A, USB-C, HDMI, SD and microSD readers, Ethernet and a headphone jack
- Power passthrough: lets you charge the laptop through the hub; check the wattage
- Display output: HDMI resolution and refresh rate, for example 4K at 30 Hz or 60 Hz
- Data speed: USB 3.0 or faster for external drives

Check that your laptop's USB-C port supports video output if you plan to connect a monitor. All hubs we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Will a USB-C hub work with my MacBook?
faqs.answer: Yes. USB-C hubs work with MacBook Air and MacBook Pro models. Note that base Apple silicon MacBooks support a limited number of external displays.

faqs.question: Can I connect a monitor through a USB hub?
faqs.answer: Yes, with a hub that has HDMI or DisplayPort, as long as your laptop's USB-C port supports video output (DisplayPort Alt Mode or Thunderbolt).

faqs.question: Can I charge my laptop through the hub?
faqs.answer: Hubs with power delivery passthrough let you plug your USB-C charger into the hub. The hub uses a little of the power itself, so the laptop receives slightly less than the charger's rating.

seoDescription: Shop genuine storage in Nepal: external SSDs and hard drives, memory cards and USB flash drives for backups and transfers.
seoContent:
## Buy storage devices in Nepal

Your photos, documents and projects are worth protecting. Portable storage lets you back up important files, carry work between computers and add space to phones, cameras and consoles.

## Storage in this section

- External SSDs: very fast, compact and shock-resistant
- External hard drives: the most capacity for the money, ideal for backups
- Memory cards: microSD and SD cards for phones, cameras, drones and the Nintendo Switch
- USB flash drives: small, cheap and handy for documents and transfers

## Avoid fake storage

Counterfeit memory cards and flash drives are common. They report a large capacity but lose data once a small amount is written. Every storage device we sell is genuine.

faqs.question: How can I tell if a memory card or pen drive is fake?
faqs.answer: Fake storage often has an unrealistically low price for its capacity, and files become corrupted once you fill it beyond its real size. Buying genuine products from a trusted seller avoids this.

faqs.question: What is the best way to back up my files?
faqs.answer: Keep at least two copies of important files: one on your computer and one on an external drive, plus a cloud backup for anything irreplaceable.

faqs.question: Do external drives work with Mac and Windows?
faqs.answer: Yes. You may need to format the drive in exFAT to use it on both. The product page notes any pre-formatted settings.

seoDescription: Shop genuine pen drives in Nepal: USB-A, USB-C and dual USB flash drives for documents, transfers and backups.
seoContent:
## Buy pen drives in Nepal

Pen drives are still the simplest way to carry documents to a print shop, share files with a classmate, install an operating system or keep a quick backup. They are small, cheap and work almost everywhere.

## How to choose a pen drive

- Connector: USB-A for most computers, USB-C for modern laptops and phones, or dual-connector drives that do both
- Speed: USB 3.0 or newer makes large file transfers far faster than USB 2.0
- Capacity: 32 to 64 GB for documents, 128 GB and up for videos and backups
- Design: metal bodies are more durable; a keyring loop helps you not lose it

## Use genuine drives

Fake pen drives often hold far less data than the label says and corrupt your files when full. All flash drives we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Can I use a USB-C pen drive with my phone?
faqs.answer: Yes, with phones that support USB OTG, which includes most recent Android phones and USB-C iPhones. Dual-connector drives work with both phones and older computers.

faqs.question: Why is my pen drive copying slowly?
faqs.answer: USB 2.0 drives or ports are much slower than USB 3.0. Many small files also copy slower than one large file. Use a USB 3.0 port, often marked in blue or with SS.

faqs.question: Can I make a bootable USB drive for Windows?
faqs.answer: Yes. A drive of 8 GB or more works with Microsoft's Media Creation Tool or similar software to install Windows.

seoDescription: Buy genuine memory cards in Nepal: microSD and SD cards for phones, cameras, drones, dash cams and the Nintendo Switch.
seoContent:
## Buy memory cards in Nepal

Memory cards add storage to phones, tablets, cameras, drones, action cameras, dash cams, CCTV cameras and the Nintendo Switch. The right card depends on the device and how fast it records.

## Understanding card speed ratings

- Class 10 and U1: fine for photos and Full HD video
- U3 and V30: needed for 4K video in cameras, drones and action cameras
- A1 and A2: faster app performance when used in phones and tablets
- Higher V ratings (V60, V90) for professional high-bitrate video

## Choose the right card

- Format: microSD for phones, drones and action cameras; full-size SD for most cameras
- Capacity: check the maximum your device supports
- Endurance cards: built for constant recording in dash cams and security cameras

Fake memory cards are common, so buy genuine. Every card we sell is genuine.

faqs.question: Which memory card do I need for 4K video?
faqs.answer: Use a card rated U3 or V30 or higher. Slower cards can stop recording or drop frames when filming 4K.

faqs.question: What is a high endurance memory card?
faqs.answer: High endurance cards are designed for constant recording in dash cams and security cameras, where normal cards wear out much faster.

faqs.question: Will a 256 GB card work in my phone?
faqs.answer: Check your phone's specifications for the maximum supported card size. Most recent phones with a card slot support large microSDXC cards.

seoDescription: Shop genuine external hard drives in Nepal: 1 TB to 5 TB+ portable HDDs for backups, photos, videos and games.
seoContent:
## Buy external hard drives in Nepal

An external hard drive gives you lots of storage at a low cost per terabyte. It is the easiest way to back up your laptop, store photo and video collections and free up space on your computer.

## How to choose an external hard drive

- Capacity: 1 TB for documents and photos, 2 TB and up for videos, games and full system backups
- Portable or desktop: portable drives are powered by USB; desktop drives offer more capacity but need a power adapter
- Connection: USB 3.0 or newer; USB-C models suit modern laptops
- Backup software and password protection on some models

## Look after your drive

Hard drives have moving parts, so avoid dropping them, especially while they are running, and always eject the drive safely before unplugging. All external hard drives we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Can I use an external hard drive with PS5 or Xbox?
faqs.answer: Yes. Consoles can use external USB drives to store games; check the console's requirements for the minimum speed and capacity.

faqs.question: How long do external hard drives last?
faqs.answer: With careful use, many last several years. Because any drive can fail, keep an additional copy of truly important files.

faqs.question: Why does my 1 TB drive show less space?
faqs.answer: Manufacturers measure 1 TB as 1000 GB while computers count in binary units, so a 1 TB drive shows about 931 GB. This is normal.

seoDescription: Buy genuine portable SSDs in Nepal: fast, compact external SSDs for backups, video editing and gaming on the go.
seoContent:
## Buy external SSDs in Nepal

A portable SSD is many times faster than an external hard drive, small enough for a pocket and has no moving parts, so it handles bumps and drops much better. It is ideal for photographers, video editors, students and anyone moving large files.

## How to choose an external SSD

- Speed: USB 3.2 Gen 2 drives reach around 1000 MB/s; faster interfaces such as USB 3.2 Gen 2x2 or Thunderbolt reach higher, if your computer supports them
- Capacity: 500 GB for documents and projects, 1 to 2 TB for photo and video work
- Connection: USB-C, with a USB-A cable or adapter for older computers
- Durability: drop resistance and water and dust ratings for fieldwork
- Compatibility: works with Windows, macOS, iPad, Android and consoles

All external SSDs we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Is an external SSD worth it over a hard drive?
faqs.answer: If you transfer large files often or edit directly from the drive, yes. SSDs are much faster, smaller and more durable. For pure backup of large archives, a hard drive is cheaper per terabyte.

faqs.question: Can I use an external SSD with my phone or iPad?
faqs.answer: Yes, with a USB-C phone or iPad that supports external storage. You can save and open files through the Files app on iPhone and iPad.

faqs.question: Why is my SSD slower than advertised?
faqs.answer: The computer's USB port and cable limit speed. Use a fast USB-C port and the cable that came with the drive to get the rated speed.

seoDescription: Buy genuine networking gear in Nepal: Wi-Fi routers, mesh Wi-Fi systems and extenders for fast internet in every room.
seoContent:
## Buy Wi-Fi routers and networking gear in Nepal

The router your internet provider gives you often cannot cover a whole house, especially in buildings with thick concrete walls and several floors. Better networking gear gives you faster, more stable internet in every room.

## Choosing the right solution

- Routers: replace a basic ISP router for faster Wi-Fi and more connected devices
- Mesh Wi-Fi: several units that work as one network to cover large homes and multi-storey buildings
- Wi-Fi extenders: an affordable fix for one or two weak spots

## What to look for

- Wi-Fi standard: Wi-Fi 6 and newer handle many devices better
- Dual-band or tri-band for less congestion
- Gigabit Ethernet ports for TVs, consoles and PCs
- An easy setup app and parental controls

All networking products we sell are genuine and work with Nepali fibre broadband connections.

faqs.question: Will a new router work with my internet provider?
faqs.answer: In most cases, yes. Many Nepali fibre connections use an ONT or modem from the provider, and you connect your own router to it. Some setups need the provider's login details; ask your ISP if unsure.

faqs.question: Mesh Wi-Fi or extender: which do I need?
faqs.answer: For a whole multi-floor house, mesh Wi-Fi gives seamless coverage. For one weak room, an extender is a cheaper fix.

faqs.question: Why is my Wi-Fi slow upstairs?
faqs.answer: Concrete floors and walls block Wi-Fi signals. Placing the router centrally helps, and a mesh system or extender on the upper floor usually solves it.

seoDescription: Shop genuine Wi-Fi routers in Nepal: dual-band and Wi-Fi 6 routers for fast, stable internet with fibre broadband.
seoContent:
## Buy WiFi routers in Nepal

A better router can make the same internet plan feel much faster. It handles more phones, laptops, TVs and smart devices at once, reaches further and keeps video calls and games stable.

## How to choose a router

- Wi-Fi standard: Wi-Fi 5 (ac) for basic needs, Wi-Fi 6 (ax) or newer for busy homes with many devices
- Speed rating: higher combined speeds help, but your real speed is limited by your internet plan
- Bands: dual-band (2.4 GHz and 5 GHz) or tri-band for less congestion
- Coverage: external antennas and beamforming improve range
- Ports: Gigabit WAN and LAN ports for fibre plans and wired devices
- Features: parental controls, guest network, QoS for gaming, and mesh support for adding units later

All routers we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Do I need a Wi-Fi 6 router?
faqs.answer: If your home has many devices or your plan is faster than about 100 Mbps, Wi-Fi 6 noticeably improves speed and stability. Your phones and laptops get the most benefit if they also support Wi-Fi 6.

faqs.question: What is the difference between 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz Wi-Fi?
faqs.answer: 2.4 GHz reaches further and passes through walls better but is slower. 5 GHz is much faster at short to medium range. A dual-band router gives you both.

faqs.question: Where should I place my router?
faqs.answer: Place it centrally and high up, away from thick walls, metal objects and the floor. Avoid cupboards and corners.

seoDescription: Shop Wi-Fi extenders and repeaters in Nepal to boost weak signals and remove dead zones in rooms and upper floors.
seoContent:
## Buy Wi-Fi extenders in Nepal

If Wi-Fi is strong in most of your home but weak in a bedroom, on the top floor or on the rooftop, a Wi-Fi extender is an affordable fix. It picks up your router's signal and rebroadcasts it to reach further.

## How to get the best results

- Place the extender halfway between the router and the weak area, where the signal is still good
- Choose a dual-band extender to keep speeds higher
- An Ethernet port lets you connect a TV or desktop to the extender
- Extenders that support mesh technology create a seamless network with compatible routers

## Extender or mesh?

For one or two weak spots, an extender works well. For large multi-storey homes, a mesh Wi-Fi system gives better, seamless coverage. All extenders we sell are genuine.

faqs.question: Does a Wi-Fi extender reduce speed?
faqs.answer: Some speed loss is normal, because the extender has to receive and resend data. Dual-band extenders and good placement keep the loss small.

faqs.question: Will an extender work with any router?
faqs.answer: Yes. Wi-Fi extenders work with standard routers from any brand or internet provider.

faqs.question: Where should I plug in the extender?
faqs.answer: Plug it in roughly halfway between the router and the dead zone, where your phone still shows a good signal. The extender's app or lights help you find the best spot.
